clue.text: Exponent backed workers body proposing current disruption

parts.note: in maths an exponent is the power to which a number is raised

indicators.note: backed means put into reverse, so the union body's letters run the other way

parts.note: the TUC is the Trades Union Congress, Britain's federation of trade unions

explanation.surface: A union body is pushing a proposal that will upset the power supply.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Exponent' looks like a supporter of a proposal, which 'proposing' plays on; 'backed' signals the reversal, and current is electric.
explanation.definitionFit: A loss of mains electricity supply is a disruption to the flow of electric current.

clue.text: Defer or deter

explanation.surface: Postpone or discourage: a choice of two near-rhyming verbs.
explanation.definitionFit: To postpone something is to put it off; to discourage someone is also to put them off.

clue.text: Party organiser is on his feet to arouse enthusiasm

parts.note: a whip keeps a political party's MPs in line and organises their votes
someone standing or out of bed is up

explanation.surface: A parliamentary whip stands up to rally his colleagues.
explanation.definitionFit: To stir up feeling or excitement in a crowd is to whip it up.

clue.text: Argumentative boatman

parts.note: a man who pulls an oar, and also one who quarrels, since to row (rhyming with cow) is to argue

explanation.surface: A quarrelsome man in a boat.
explanation.definitionFit: An oarsman propels a boat, and the same spelling names one who has rows, or arguments.

clue.text: British gunners in Eastern European state

parts.note: UK, the United Kingdom
RA is the Royal Artillery, the army's gunners
E is the abbreviation for east or eastern

explanation.surface: British artillery deployed in a country in eastern Europe.
explanation.definitionFit: Kyiv is the capital of this large country in eastern Europe.

clue.text: Hold up a box of festive goodies

definitions.meaning: a basket of food and drink given at Christmas

explanation.surface: Something delays the arrival of a Christmas food box.
explanation.definitionFit: To impede or obstruct progress; also a wicker basket of food and drink given as a Christmas present.

clue.text: Assorted ales again bring freedom from pain

indicators.note: assorted means mixed up, so the letters of the two words are jumbled together

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Another round of mixed beers numbs the drinker's aches.
explanation.definitionFit: Medical term for the absence of the sense of pain, as produced by a painkilling drug.

clue.text: Didn't stop a fellow past his prime

parts.note: passé means faded, past one's best
a don is a fellow or lecturer at a university such as Oxford or Cambridge

explanation.surface: An ageing university fellow kept going regardless.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who moved on without halting went past, continuing on their way.

clue.text: Consider putting spirit in tea blend

parts.note: rum is a spirit distilled from sugar cane

indicators.note: a blend is a mixture, so the letters of the drink are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Thinking about spiking a cup of tea with a dash of rum.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tea blend' reads as a mix of leaves; 'blend' is the anagram signal working on the drink's name alone.
explanation.definitionFit: To ponder or turn something over in the mind at length.

clue.text: Holiday telegram may trigger alarm

parts.note: a trip is a short holiday or outing
a wire is an old word for a telegram

explanation.surface: A message about a holiday sets off a panic.
explanation.definitionFit: A taut thread or cable that sets off a device, such as an alarm or a trap, when someone passes.

clue.text: Light wood with head of match for relief from cold

parts.note: balsa is a very light tropical timber used for models

indicators.note: the head of a word is its first letter, taken from match

explanation.surface: Striking a match against light wood for warmth on a cold day.
explanation.definitionFit: An aromatic resinous ointment or inhalant, traditionally used to soothe colds and congestion.

clue.text: Getting on despite being caught in tragedy

indicators.note: the letters are trapped inside the word tragedy, which holds the answer within it

explanation.surface: Growing old in spite of being caught up in a tragic event.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone getting on in years is old.

clue.text: Taking a plane around old city railway is confusing

indicators.note: around puts the air travel word on both sides of the city and railway pieces

parts.note: travelling by air is flying
Ur is the ancient city of Mesopotamia, a crossword staple
railway gives R

explanation.surface: Air travel round an ancient city by rail is bewildering.
explanation.definitionFit: To fluster or agitate someone, throwing them into a nervous state.

clue.text: Showing jealousy is not sophisticated

explanation.surface: Envy reveals a lack of worldliness.
explanation.definitionFit: Envy is called the green-eyed monster; a raw novice is green, inexperienced and naive.

clue.text: The cost of railway food

definitions.meaning: the price paid for a train journey

explanation.surface: A complaint about the price of train catering.
explanation.definitionFit: The price of a ticket for a journey; also meals or provisions, as in good plain cooking.

clue.text: Previously Sally went round New York as a romantic consultant

indicators.note: Sally goes round to the far side of the city, coming after it in the answer

parts.note: ago means in the past, previously
an Aunt Sally is a British fairground target; Sally brings to mind Aunt

explanation.surface: A woman called Sally once toured New York as a love adviser.
explanation.walkthrough: An Aunt Sally is a figure at a British fair thrown at; here Sally summons its partner word.
explanation.definitionFit: A newspaper columnist who answers readers' letters about problems of love and relationships.

clue.text: US barman has to buy the drinks and rush off

parts.note: a DA, district attorney, is an American lawyer, a member of the bar
in British and Australian slang to shout is to stand a round

explanation.surface: An American bartender has to stand a round and then hurry away.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Barman' suggests a pub; it means a lawyer of the bar. To shout a round is everyday British slang for buying everyone's drinks.
explanation.definitionFit: To leave in a hurry, darting away suddenly.

clue.text: Wise man takes step in time for rocket travel

indicators.note: the wise man takes the step into himself, holding it inside

parts.note: a sage is a wise man
a pace is a single step

explanation.surface: A wise man moves forward step by step towards spaceflight.
explanation.definitionFit: The modern era of space exploration that began with satellites and manned rockets.

clue.text: He's owed money by councillor and paper producer

parts.note: an editor produces a newspaper

explanation.surface: A local councillor and a newspaper boss are both in debt to someone.
explanation.definitionFit: A lender is the person to whom a debt is due.

clue.text: Put on a show for each class

parts.note: per means for each, as in per head
a form is a school class

explanation.surface: Every school class stages an entertainment.
explanation.definitionFit: To act, sing or play before an audience.

clue.text: Compelled oriental mother to return

indicators.note: to return is to go back, so the combined letters are read in the opposite direction

parts.note: E for eastern, oriental
a dam is an animal's mother

explanation.surface: An eastern mother is forced to come back home.
explanation.definitionFit: Forced to do something, as in he was obliged to apologise.

clue.text: Worst way to administer corporal punishment

definitions.meaning: a regular route, as a policeman's patrol

explanation.surface: Debating the harshest method of physical punishment.
explanation.definitionFit: Defeat; a policeman's regular round or patrol route; to thrash or strike repeatedly.

clue.text: Retire with a slipped disc

definitions.meaning: having one's back displaced, put out

explanation.surface: Stepping down because of a spinal injury.
explanation.definitionFit: To withdraw from an undertaking; read literally, a slipped disc leaves one's spine displaced.

clue.text: How chess game finishes for a resident

definitions.meaning: someone living in a prison or hospital

explanation.surface: A chess game ending for someone who lives in.
explanation.definitionFit: A chess game ends in checkmate; a prisoner or patient living in an institution is a resident of it.

clue.text: He rings the bell while church service is in progress

parts.note: Sext is the church office said at the sixth hour, around midday
something happening now is on

explanation.surface: The bell ringer pulls the rope while a church service goes on.
explanation.definitionFit: A church officer who looks after the building and churchyard, traditionally also ringing the bell.

clue.text: Club-man takes a theologian into Cyprus

indicators.note: into puts the article and the theologian inside the country code

parts.note: CY is the international code for Cyprus
DD is Doctor of Divinity, a theologian

explanation.surface: A golf club employee brings a divinity scholar over to Cyprus.
explanation.definitionFit: On a golf course, the person who carries a player's clubs.

clue.text: Corruption of French intonation

parts.note: de is French for of
cadence is the rise and fall of the voice

explanation.surface: Moral decline revealed in a French accent.
explanation.definitionFit: Moral or cultural decay, a falling away from former standards.

clue.text: Big noise meets Her Majesty in the cafeteria

parts.note: a din is a loud noise
ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the Queen

explanation.surface: A commotion as the Queen visits the canteen.
explanation.definitionFit: A cheap roadside restaurant, especially in America, serving simple meals.

clue.text: Behaves badly when play is over

parts.note: a play is divided into acts, its sections
time that has run out is up

explanation.surface: Misbehaviour breaks out once the performance has finished.
explanation.definitionFit: A child or machine that misbehaves or malfunctions is said to be playing up.

clue.text: Blue feathers get thrown

parts.note: down is soft fine feathers
cast means thrown

explanation.surface: Feathers are tossed into the air.
explanation.definitionFit: Feeling blue means feeling low, dejected and sad.

clue.text: In time a deserter makes mistakes

indicators.note: in puts the deserter inside the span of time

parts.note: an era is a period of time
a rat is one who deserts, as rats leave a sinking ship

explanation.surface: Eventually a deserter slips up.
explanation.definitionFit: A list of printing errors found after publication; the Latin plural for errors.

clue.text: Virtuous man gets given egg on fish

parts.note: ST, a saint, is a virtuous man
to urge on is to encourage, egg on

explanation.surface: A saintly man is encouraged by a fish dish with an egg.
explanation.walkthrough: 'egg' looks like food beside 'fish'; 'egg on' is the verb meaning encourage.
explanation.definitionFit: A large fish whose roe is caviar.
